config.universal-emotes.title: Emote Wheel Settings
config.universal-emotes.client.tps: Switch to third person after every emote
config.universal-emotes.client.tps.toolt: When enabled, camera perspective changes to third person every time you start an emote.
config.universal-emotes.client.mute.tool: When enabled, emote audios are silenced.
config.universal-emotes.client.dmca.tool: If there is an alternative to sounds or music marked as copyrighted by emote creators, it will play that alternative; otherwise, it will not play any sound at all.
config.universal-emotes.client.particles: When enabled, emote particle effects will be hidden.
config.universal-emotes.client.hide_armo: When enabled, your worn armor is hidden while you are emoting, for you and for players in server.
config.universal-emotes.client.hide_held: When enabled, whatever you are holding is hidden while you are emoting, for you and for players in server.
config.universal-emotes.client.accent_co: The highlight color used for the emote wheel selection and the rotating indicator.
config.universal-emotes.server.readonly: You are connected to a server and do not have permission to change these settings, so they are read-only. They can be edited only by a server operator.
config.universal-emotes.server.ignore_op: When enabled, emotes which requires an operator level can be used by everyone.
config.universal-emotes.server.level_req: When enabled, each emote requires a minimum experience level based on its rarity.
config.universal-emotes.server.damage_no: Disallow interrupting emotes upon receiving damage
When enabled, taking damage during an emote does not quits emoting.
config.universal-emotes.server.rarity_le: Minimum experience level required to use emotes of this rarity.
commands.universal-emotes.reload.success: Succesfully %s bundles and %s emotes reloaded and re-synced for %s players.
